lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਰਥੁ ਇਕੁ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mer sareer kaa ik rath ik rathavaahu ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul of the body has one chariot and one charioteer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਵਟਾਈਅਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug pher vataaeeahi giaanee bujhahi taahi ||
lines.translation: In age after age they change; the spiritually wise understand this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਰਥੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satajug rath sa(n)tokh kaa dharam agai rathavaahu ||
lines.translation: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, contentment was the chariot and righteousness the charioteer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਰਥੁ ਜਤੈ ਕਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tretai rath jatai kaa jor agai rathavaahu ||
lines.translation: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, celibacy was the chariot and power the charioteer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਰਥੁ ਤਪੈ ਕਾ ਸਤੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: duaapur rath tapai kaa sat agai rathavaahu ||
lines.translation: In the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, penance was the chariot and truth the charioteer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਰਥੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kalajug rath agan kaa kooR agai rathavaahu ||1||
lines.translation: In the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, fire is the chariot and falsehood the charioteer. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਮ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਤੰਬਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਆਛੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saam kahai seta(n)bar suaamee sach mahi aachhai saach rahe ||
lines.translation: The Sama Veda says that the Lord Master is robed in white; in the Age of Truth,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko sach samaavai ||
lines.translation: Everyone desired Truth, abided in Truth, and was merged in the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਗੁ ਕਹੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: rig kahai rahiaa bharapoor ||
lines.translation: The Rig Veda says that God is permeating and pervading everywhere;

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam devaa mahi soor ||
lines.translation: among the deities, the Lord's Name is the most exalted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai laiai paraachhat jaahi ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name, sins depart;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਉ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tau mokha(n)tar paahi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, then, one obtains salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਜ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਛਲੀ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਵਲਿ ਕਾਨੑ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਜਾਦਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: juj mahi jor chhalee cha(n)draaval kaanh krisan jaadam bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the Jujar Veda, Kaan Krishna of the Yaadva tribe seduced Chandraavali by force.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਗੋਪੀ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarajaat gopee lai aaiaa bi(n)draaban mahi ra(n)g keeaa ||
lines.translation: He brought the Elysian Tree for his milk-maid, and revelled in Brindaaban.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ਹੂਆ ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਅਲਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal mahi bed atharaban hooaa naau khudaaee alahu bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Atharva Veda became prominent; Allah became the Name of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਤੁਰਕ ਪਠਾਣੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: neel basatr le kapaRe pahire turak pathaanee amal keeaa ||
lines.translation: Men began to wear blue robes and garments; Turks and Pat'haans assumed power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਹੋਏ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaare ved hoe sachiaar ||
lines.translation: The four Vedas each claim to be true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਹਿ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: paRahi gunahi tinh chaar veechaar ||
lines.translation: Reading and studying them, four doctrines are found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaau bhagat kar neech sadaae ||
lines.translation: With loving devotional worship, abiding in humility,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tau naanak mokha(n)tar paae ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, salvation is attained. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur vitahu vaariaa jit miliai khasam samaaliaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru; meeting Him, I have come to cherish the Lord Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਇਨੑੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kar upades giaan a(n)jan deeaa inhee netree jagat nihaaliaa ||
lines.translation: He has taught me and given me the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and with these eyes, I behold the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: khasam chhod doojai lage dube se vanajaariaa ||
lines.translation: Those dealers who abandon their Lord and Master and attach themselves to another, are drowned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satiguroo hai bohithaa viralai kinai veechaariaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the boat, but few are those who realize this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa paar utaariaa ||13||
lines.translation: Granting His Grace, He carries them across. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮਲ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰਾਇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਦੀਰਘ ਅਤਿ ਮੁਚੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: si(n)mal rukh saraairaa at deeragh at much ||
lines.translation: The simmal tree is straight as an arrow; it is very tall, and very thick.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi j aavahi aas kar jaahi niraase kit ||
lines.translation: But those birds which visit it hopefully, depart disappointed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਫਿਕੇ ਫੁਲ ਬਕਬਕੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਪਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: phal phike phul bakabake ka(n)m na aavahi pat ||
lines.translation: Its fruits are tasteless, its flowers are nauseating, and its leaves are useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਤੁ ਨੀਵੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਤਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mithat neevee naanakaa gun cha(n)giaaeeaa tat ||
lines.translation: Sweetness and humility, O Nanak, are the essence of virtue and goodness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਵੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਨਿਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko nivai aap kau par kau nivai na koi ||
lines.translation: Everyone bows down to himself; no one bows down to another.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੂ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਉਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhar taaraajoo toleeai nivai s gauraa hoi ||
lines.translation: When something is placed on the balancing scale and weighed, the side which descends is heavier.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਦੂਣਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਜੋ ਹੰਤਾ ਮਿਰਗਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aparaadhee doonaa nivai jo ha(n)taa miragaahi ||
lines.translation: The sinner, like the deer hunter, bows down twice as much.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਇਐ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਕੁਸੁਧੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sees nivaaiai kiaa theeai jaa ridai kusudhe jaahi ||1||
lines.translation: But what can be achieved by bowing the head, when the heart is impure? ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੁਸਤਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR pusatak sa(n)dhiaa baada(n) ||
lines.translation: You read your books and say your prayers, and then engage in debate;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਲ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sil poojas bagul samaadha(n) ||
lines.translation: you worship stones and sit like a stork, pretending to be in Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਭੂਖਣ ਸਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukh jhooth bibhookhan saara(n) ||
lines.translation: With your mouth you utter falsehood, and you adorn yourself with precious decorations;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈਪਾਲ ਤਿਹਾਲ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: traipaal tihaal bichaara(n) ||
lines.translation: you recite the three lines of the Gayatri three times a day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਲਿਲਾਟੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: gal maalaa tilak lilaata(n) ||
lines.translation: Around your neck is a rosary, and on your forehead is a sacred mark;

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਧੋਤੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਪਾਟੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: dui dhotee basatr kapaata(n) ||
lines.translation: upon your head is a turban, and you wear two loin cloths.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਸਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: je jaanas brahama(n) karama(n) ||
lines.translation: If you knew the nature of God,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਫੋਕਟ ਨਿਸਚਉ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh phokat nisachau karama(n) ||
lines.translation: you would know that all of these beliefs and rituals are in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak nihachau dhiaavai ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, meditate with deep faith;

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vin satigur vaat na paavai ||2||
lines.translation: without the True Guru, no one finds the Way. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਪੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਛਡਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kapaR roop suhaavanaa chhad duneeaa a(n)dar jaavanaa ||
lines.translation: Abandoning the world of beauty, and beautiful clothes, one must depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)daa cha(n)gaa aapanaa aape hee keetaa paavanaa ||
lines.translation: He obtains the rewards of his good and bad deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮ ਕੀਏ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਰਾਹਿ ਭੀੜੈ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam keee man bhaavade raahi bheeRai agai jaavanaa ||
lines.translation: He may issue whatever commands he wishes, but he shall have to take to the narrow path hereafter.
